# Introduction
Goal: To define a robust molecular boundary differentiating "Active-like" from "Control-like" profiles within the clinical "Non-Active" SSc cohort. 

We generate a continuous polarity-aligned heatmap score based on the SSc disease signature. We then perform a sensitivity analysis by slicing this continuous score at three distinct thresholds (50/50, 40/60, and 60/40) and executing parallel downstream Clinical Phenotyping, Differential Expression Analysis (DEA), and Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA). Finally, cross-contrast visualization validates the biological stability of the molecular boundary.

```{r setup_boxes, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("code", "00_config.R"))
```

# Setup and Import
`r what_this_does("Sourced configuration and engine scripts. Imported clinical spines, data dictionary, proteomics matrices, and the master Active vs Control DEA signature.", "Defined pathway database targets for downstream GSEA.")`

```{r setup_and_import, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(here)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggrepel)
library(msigdbr)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Paths
current_file <- "03d_proteomics_subgroups"
output_dir_data <- here::here("output", current_file)
if (!dir.exists(output_dir_data)) dir.create(output_dir_data, recursive = TRUE)
assets_dir <- here::here("docs", "assets", current_file)
if (!dir.exists(assets_dir)) dir.create(assets_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# Global DEA Path
proteomics_dea_path <- here::here("output", "03b_proteomics_differential")

# Source Engines
source(here::here("code", "01_general_engines.R"))
source(here::here("code", "02_proteomics_engines.R"))

# Load Data
master_spine  <- readRDS(here::here("output", "01b_clinical_feature_engineering", "curated_clinical_spine.rds"))
data_dict     <- readRDS(here::here("output", "01b_clinical_feature_engineering", "clinical_data_dictionary.rds")) 
olink_mat     <- readRDS(here::here("output", "01a_data_import_and_qc", "clean_olink_matrix.rds"))
svc_dea       <- readRDS(here::here("output", "03b_proteomics_differential", "ssc_vs_control.rds"))

pathway_dbs <- list(
  "Hallmark" = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol),
  "GO_BP" = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5", subcategory = "BP") %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol),
  "GO_Cell_Death" = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5", subcategory = "BP") %>% filter(gs_name == "GOBP_CELL_DEATH") %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol),
  "Reactome_programmed_cell_death" = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:REACTOME") %>% filter(gs_name == "REACTOME_PROGRAMMED_CELL_DEATH") %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol),
  "GO_Pyroptosis" = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5", subcategory = "BP") %>% filter(gs_name == "GOBP_PYROPTOSIS") %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol),
  "GO_Regulation_of_pyroptosis" = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5", subcategory = "BP") %>% filter(gs_name == "GOBP_REGULATION_OF_PYROPTOSIS") %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
)
```


# Configuration
`r what_this_does("Established highly parameterized lists controlling heatmap extraction, subgroup quantiles, clinical phenotyping parameters, DEA models, and cross-contrast algorithms to exactly mirror the architecture of the 03c clustering script.")`

```{r configuration}
# 1. Subgroup Definitions
groups <- list(
  active = GRP_ACTIVE,
  control = GRP_CONTROL,
  target = GRP_NON_ACTIVE
)

hm_conf <- list(
  top_n_prot = 30
)

split_conf <- list(
  # Standard Percentile Cutoff (Higher Score = Active-Like)
  Split_50_50 = 0.50,
  
  # Control-Bound Cutoff
  # 1.00 = 100th percentile (Strict Max). Change to 0.95 to drop top 5% of healthy outliers.
  control_bound_percentile = 1.00 
)

# 2. Variable Definitions
pheno_vars_to_include <- data_dict %>% filter(QC_Flag == "PASS") %>% pull(Variable)

clin_vars_to_highlight <- list(
  "SSc clinical parameters" = ssc_clinical_parameters,
  "Medication" = clinical_domains$Medications,
  "Demographics_and_Scores" = clinical_domains$Demographics_and_Scores
)

clin_vars_to_include <- list(
  "Exploratory" = c(clinical_domains$Pulmonary, clinical_domains$Cardiac, clinical_domains$Labs_and_Biomarkers, clinical_domains$Cutaneous_and_Vascular, clinical_domains$Musculoskeletal, clinical_domains$Gastrointestinal, clinical_domains$Medications) 
)

# Map dynamic variables to custom colors wrapper
custom_colors <- setNames(c("#c0392b", "#2980b9"), c("Active-Like", "Control-Like"))

# 3. Clinical Phenotyping Configs
pheno_configs <- list(
  pheno_splits = list(
    target_job = "job_splits",
    title = "Non-Active Subgroup Phenotyping",
    target_algorithms = c("Split_50_50", "Split_Control_Bound"), 
    subset_filter = NULL,
    variables = clin_vars_to_include,
    highlight_variables = clin_vars_to_highlight,
    p_cutoff = 0.05,
    must_include_vars = c()
  )
)

# 4. Feature Phenotyping Targets (DEA)
feature_configs <- list(
  feat_splits = list(
    target_job = "job_splits",
    title = "Subgroup Differential Expression",
    input_matrix = "raw", 
    covariates = c("Age", "Sex"),
    algorithms = list(
      Split_50_50 = list(
        contrasts = list(active_vs_control = list(title = "50/50: Active-Like vs Control-Like", desc = "Split at median", target=c("Active-Like"), ref=c("Control-Like"), subset_filter = NULL))
      ),
      Split_Control_Bound = list( 
        contrasts = list(active_vs_control = list(title = "Control-Bound: Active-Like vs Control-Like", desc = paste0("Split at ", split_conf$control_bound_percentile * 100, "th percentile of Controls"), target=c("Active-Like"), ref=c("Control-Like"), subset_filter = NULL))
      )
    ),
    dea_p_cutoff = 0.05,
    dea_fc_cutoff = 0.58
  )
)

# 5. DEA Heatmap & Omics Configs
heatmap_config <- list(
  top_n = 30,
  split_by_group = TRUE, 
  row_font_size = 8,
  annotation_vars = c("cohort_group", "Age", "Sex")
)

omics_config <- list(
  gsea_p_cutoff  = 0.05, 
  gsea_min_size  = 10,
  network_p_cutoff = 0.05
)

# 6. Cross-Contrast Configs (Stability Analysis)
cross_contrast_configs <- list(
  cc_50_vs_cb = list( 
    title = "Stability: 50/50 vs Control-Bound Split",
    x_source = "feat_splits_Split_50_50_active_vs_control", 
    y_source = "feat_splits_Split_Control_Bound_active_vs_control",
    x_label = "50/50 Split",
    y_label = "Control Bound",
    color_x = "#e67e22", 
    color_y = "#2980b9", 
    highlight_color = "#27ae60", 
    top_n_specific = 10,
    top_n_shared = 10,
    p_cutoff = 0.05,  
    fc_cutoff = 0.58
  )
)
```

# Scoring
`r analysis_decision("Data Isolation: Filtering exclusively to the Non-Active cohort before calculating quantiles ensures the arbitrary splits accurately reflect distributions within the target group.", "Biological Anchoring: The 'Control-Bound' split defines the threshold using the true maximum observed molecular score of the healthy control cohort, anchoring the categorization to a physiological baseline.", "Payload Injection: Emulated the clustering engine structure to allow downstream DEA and Phenotyping modules to analyze rule-based thresholds flawlessly.")`
`r what_this_does("Generates a Master Pi-score Heatmap using the central engine. Extracts the unbroken physical leaf order to assign a 0-100 percentile rank score. Splits continuous scores by predefined percentiles and the maximum Control score, building a unified global_cluster_payloads object.")`

```{r scoring, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# 1. Prepare Clinical Data
hm_clin <- master_spine %>% filter(!is.na(cohort_group)) %>% droplevels()

# 2. Generate Heatmap via Engine (Uses Pi-score & Project Aesthetics)
hm_obj <- run_heatmap_engine(
  mat = olink_mat,
  clin = hm_clin,
  dea_res = svc_dea,
  title = "Global SSc Disease Signature",
  n_top = hm_conf$top_n_prot,
  split_by_group = FALSE, # MUST be FALSE to maintain an unbroken dendrogram for ranking
  show_top_n_title = TRUE,
  annotation_vars = heatmap_config$annotation_vars
)

# 3. Draw Heatmap & Extract Order
hm_drawn <- draw(hm_obj, padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "mm"))

order_idx <- column_order(hm_drawn)

# Reconstruct the exact clinical subset used inside the engine to map indices safely
valid_ids <- intersect(hm_clin$Subject_ID, colnames(olink_mat))
engine_clin_sub <- hm_clin %>% filter(Subject_ID %in% valid_ids)
ordered_ids <- engine_clin_sub$Subject_ID[order_idx]

# 4. Map to 0-100 Percentile Rank
hm_df <- data.frame(Subject_ID = ordered_ids, HM_Rank = 1:length(ordered_ids)) %>%
  mutate(HM_Percentile = (HM_Rank / max(HM_Rank)) * 100) %>%
  inner_join(engine_clin_sub %>% select(Subject_ID, cohort_group), by="Subject_ID")

# 5. Polarity Check & Correction
mean_active <- mean(hm_df$HM_Percentile[hm_df$cohort_group == groups$active])
mean_control <- mean(hm_df$HM_Percentile[hm_df$cohort_group == groups$control])

if (mean_active < mean_control) { hm_df$HM_Active_Score <- 100 - hm_df$HM_Percentile } else { hm_df$HM_Active_Score <- hm_df$HM_Percentile }

# --- Extract Control Threshold BEFORE filtering ---
control_scores <- hm_df %>% filter(cohort_group == groups$control) %>% pull(HM_Active_Score)
cutoff_cb <- quantile(control_scores, probs = split_conf$control_bound_percentile, na.rm=TRUE)

# Filter down to Non-Actives
hm_final <- hm_df %>% filter(cohort_group == groups$target) %>% select(Subject_ID, HM_Active_Score)

# 6. Calculate Internal Thresholds & Append Binary Columns
cutoff_50 <- quantile(hm_final$HM_Active_Score, probs = split_conf$Split_50_50, na.rm=TRUE)

split_spine <- hm_final %>%
  mutate(
    Split_50_50 = ifelse(HM_Active_Score > cutoff_50, "Active-Like", "Control-Like"),
    Split_Control_Bound = ifelse(HM_Active_Score > cutoff_cb, "Active-Like", "Control-Like") 
  )

# Update Master Spine globally for downstream engines
master_spine <- master_spine %>% left_join(split_spine %>% select(-HM_Active_Score), by="Subject_ID")

# 7. Initialize Global Target Dummy Payload
global_cluster_payloads <- list()
global_cluster_payloads[["job_splits"]] <- list(
  status = "success",
  data = list(
    assignments = list(
      Split_50_50 = setNames(split_spine$Split_50_50, split_spine$Subject_ID),
      Split_Control_Bound = setNames(split_spine$Split_Control_Bound, split_spine$Subject_ID) 
    )
  )
)

saveRDS(split_spine, file.path(output_dir_data, "non_active_splits.rds"))

# Print Diagnostics to verify group sizes
cat("=== Subgroup Sizes ===\n")
cat(sprintf("50/50 Split: %d Active-Like | %d Control-Like\n", sum(split_spine$Split_50_50=="Active-Like"), sum(split_spine$Split_50_50=="Control-Like")))
cat(sprintf("Control-Bound Split: %d Active-Like | %d Control-Like\n", sum(split_spine$Split_Control_Bound=="Active-Like"), sum(split_spine$Split_Control_Bound=="Control-Like")))

# Cleanup
rm(hm_obj, hm_drawn, hm_df); invisible(gc())
```

# Clinical Phenotyping {.tabset}
`r analysis_decision("Muted non-significant phenotypes (p >= 0.05) to zero on the heatmap, ensuring visual emphasis is strictly placed on true biological drivers rather than random noise.")`
`r what_this_does("Calculates Log-Odds Ratios and Z-Scores to map the clinical fingerprint of the discovered endotypes. Uses nested categories for streamlined visual profiling.")`

```{r clinical_phenotyping, fig.height=16, fig.width=14, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
for (p_id in names(pheno_configs)) {
  conf <- pheno_configs[[p_id]]
  cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s {.tabset}\n\n", conf$title))
  
  payload <- global_cluster_payloads[[conf$target_job]]
  if (is.null(payload)) next
  
  res <- wrap_clinical_phenotyping(payload, master_spine, data_dict, conf, p_id, output_dir_data)
  
  if (res$status == "success") {
    for (algo in names(res$plots)) {
      cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s {.tabset}\n\n", gsub("_", " ", toupper(algo))))
      
      # Heatmaps
      if (length(res$plots[[algo]]$heatmap) > 0) {
        for (h_name in names(res$plots[[algo]]$heatmap)) {
          cat(sprintf("\n\n#### Heatmap: %s\n\n", gsub("_", " ", h_name)))
          ComplexHeatmap::draw(res$plots[[algo]]$heatmap[[h_name]])
          cat("\n\n")
        }
      }
      
      # Highlights
      if (length(res$plots[[algo]]$highlights) > 0) {
        for (g_name in names(res$plots[[algo]]$highlights)) {
          cat(sprintf("\n\n#### Grid: %s\n\n", gsub("_", " ", g_name)))
          print(res$plots[[algo]]$highlights[[g_name]])
          cat("\n\n")
        }
      }
      
      # Tables
      cat("\n\n#### Summary Table\n\n")
      if (!is.null(res$tables[[algo]])) {
        tbl <- res$tables[[algo]] %>% 
          gtsummary::as_kable_extra(caption = sprintf("Clinical Summary: %s", gsub("_", " ", toupper(algo)))) %>%
          kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = TRUE) %>%
          kableExtra::scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "600px")
        
        cat("```{=html}\n")
        print(tbl)
        cat("\n```\n\n")
      }
    }
  }
}
```


# Differential Expression {.tabset}
`r analysis_decision("Dynamic Covariate Validation: Before executing Limma for each split, the script dynamically verifies variance for requested covariates. If a covariate lacks variance within a specific split, it is dropped to prevent algebraic crashes.")`
`r what_this_does("Runs rigorous Differential Expression Analysis directly comparing Active-Like vs Control-Like groups across all requested splits. Calculates pathway enrichment via GSEA.")`

```{r differential_expression, fig.width=12, fig.height=10, results='asis'}
global_dea_payloads <- list()

for (f_id in names(feature_configs)) {
  conf <- feature_configs[[f_id]]
  payload <- global_cluster_payloads[[conf$target_job]]
  
  if (is.null(payload)) next

  cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s {.tabset}\n\n", conf$title))

  for (algo_name in names(conf$algorithms)) {
    cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s {.tabset}\n\n", gsub("_", " ", toupper(algo_name))))
    
    # Inject cluster labels for this algorithm target
    temp_spine <- master_spine
    temp_spine$Dynamic_Cluster <- as.character(payload$data$assignments[[algo_name]][match(temp_spine$Subject_ID, names(payload$data$assignments[[algo_name]]))])
    temp_spine <- temp_spine %>% filter(!is.na(Dynamic_Cluster))

    algo_conf <- conf$algorithms[[algo_name]]
    
    for (contrast_name in names(algo_conf$contrasts)) {
      c_conf <- algo_conf$contrasts[[contrast_name]]
      
      cat(sprintf("\n\n#### %s\n\n", c_conf$title))
      cat(sprintf("**Description:** %s\n\n", c_conf$desc))

      contrast_df <- temp_spine

      # Failsafe Covariate Check
      valid_covs <- c()
      for (cov in conf$covariates) {
        if (cov %in% colnames(contrast_df) && length(unique(na.omit(contrast_df[[cov]]))) > 1) {
          valid_covs <- c(valid_covs, cov)
        } else {
          message(sprintf("Warning: Covariate '%s' dropped for %s due to zero variance.", cov, c_conf$title))
        }
      }

      dea_conf <- list(
        title = sprintf("%s | Alg: %s", c_conf$title, toupper(algo_name)),
        group_col = "Dynamic_Cluster",
        target_groups = c_conf$target,
        ref_groups = c_conf$ref,
        covariates = valid_covs,
        dea_p_cutoff = conf$dea_p_cutoff,
        dea_fc_cutoff = conf$dea_fc_cutoff
      )
      
      job_name_full <- sprintf("%s_%s_%s", f_id, algo_name, contrast_name)
      
      res <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(
        wrap_dea_pipeline(
                omics_mat = olink_mat, 
                clin_df = contrast_df, 
                dea_conf = dea_conf, 
                dea_id = job_name_full, 
                base_output_dir = output_dir_data, 
                go_db = NULL, 
                omics_config = omics_config, 
                heatmap_config = heatmap_config, 
                project_colors_func = function(x) get_project_colors(x, custom_colors),
                assets_dir = assets_dir
              )
      ))
      
      if (res$status == "success") {
        
        global_dea_payloads[[job_name_full]] <- res$data$dea

        # 1. TABLE
        if (nrow(res$tables$significant_proteins) > 0) {
          tbl <- head(res$tables$significant_proteins, 50) %>% 
            mutate(logFC = round(logFC, 2), adj.P.Val = formatC(adj.P.Val, format = "e", digits = 2)) %>%
            kableExtra::kbl(format = "html", caption = "Top 50 Significant Proteins") %>% 
            kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")) %>%
            kableExtra::scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "600px")
          
          cat("```{=html}\n")
          print(tbl)
          cat("\n```\n\n")
        }
        
        # 2. VOLCANO PLOT
        if (!is.null(res$plots$volcano)) {
          if (interactive()) { print(res$plots$volcano); cat("\n\n") }
          else { cat(sprintf("<img src='assets/03d_proteomics_subgroups/%s_volcano.png' width='100%%' />\n\n", job_name_full)) }
        }
        
        # 3. COMPLEXHEATMAP 
        if (!is.null(res$plots$heatmap)) {
          if (interactive()) { ComplexHeatmap::draw(res$plots$heatmap); cat("\n\n") }
          else { cat(sprintf("<img src='assets/03d_proteomics_subgroups/%s_heatmap.png' width='100%%' />\n\n", job_name_full)) }
        }
        
        # 4. GSEA PLOTS
        if (length(res$plots$gsea) > 0) {
          cat("\n\n##### Pathway Analysis {.tabset}\n\n")
          
          for (db_name in names(res$plots$gsea)) {
            cat(sprintf("\n\n###### %s\n\n", db_name))
            p_obj <- res$plots$gsea[[db_name]]
            
            if (!is.null(p_obj$dotplot)) {
              if (interactive()) { print(p_obj$dotplot); cat("\n\n") }
              else { cat(sprintf("<img src='assets/03d_proteomics_subgroups/%s_%s_dotplot.png' width='100%%' />\n\n", job_name_full, db_name)) }
            }
            if (!is.null(p_obj$ridgeplot)) {
              if (interactive()) { print(p_obj$ridgeplot); cat("\n\n") }
              else { cat(sprintf("<img src='assets/03d_proteomics_subgroups/%s_%s_ridgeplot.png' width='100%%' />\n\n", job_name_full, db_name)) }
            }
            if (!is.null(p_obj$emap)) {
              if (interactive()) { print(p_obj$emap); cat("\n\n") }
              else { cat(sprintf("<img src='assets/03d_proteomics_subgroups/%s_%s_emap.png' width='100%%' />\n\n", job_name_full, db_name)) }
            }
          }
        } else {
          cat("*Note: No pathways passed FDR for any database.* \n\n")
        }
      }
    }
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```


# Cross-Contrast {.tabset}
`r what_this_does("Projects biological stability across varying subgroup thresholds.", "Generates logFC-to-logFC scatterplots mapping the expression stability of individual proteins regardless of exactly where the boundary percentile was drawn.", "Extracts highly specific and fundamentally shared drivers via data tables.")`

```{r cross_contrast, results='asis', fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
cc_dir <- file.path(output_dir_data, "Cross_Contrasts")
if (!dir.exists(cc_dir)) dir.create(cc_dir, recursive = TRUE)

for (cc_id in names(cross_contrast_configs)) {
  conf <- cross_contrast_configs[[cc_id]]
  
  cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s {.tabset .tabset-pills}\n\n", conf$title))
  
  dea_x <- if (exists(conf$x_source)) get(conf$x_source) else global_dea_payloads[[conf$x_source]]
  dea_y <- if (exists(conf$y_source)) get(conf$y_source) else global_dea_payloads[[conf$y_source]]
  
  if (is.null(dea_x) || is.null(dea_y)) {
    cat(sprintf("*Error: Could not locate DEA source payload(s) for %s.*\n\n", cc_id))
    next
  }
  
  cc_res <- run_cross_contrast_engine(
    dea_x = dea_x, 
    dea_y = dea_y, 
    conf = conf, 
    x_label = conf$x_label, 
    y_label = conf$y_label, 
    color_x = conf$color_x, 
    color_y = conf$color_y, 
    highlight_color = conf$highlight_color, 
    title = conf$title
  )
  
  if (!is.null(cc_res)) {
    
    cat("\n\n### Scatter Plot\n\n")
    
    ggsave(file.path(cc_dir, paste0(cc_id, "_cross_contrast.png")), cc_res$plot, width = 9, height = 7, bg = "white")
    if (!is.null(assets_dir)) {
      ggsave(file.path(assets_dir, paste0(cc_id, "_cross_contrast.png")), cc_res$plot, width = 9, height = 7, bg = "white")
    }
    
    if (interactive()) {
      print(cc_res$plot)
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("<img src='assets/03d_proteomics_subgroups/%s_cross_contrast.png' width='100%%' />\n\n", cc_id))
    }
    
    cat("\n\n### Driver Tables\n\n")
    
    table_list <- list(
      "Shared Drivers" = cc_res$tables$shared,
      "temp_x" = cc_res$tables$x_specific,
      "temp_y" = cc_res$tables$y_specific
    )
    names(table_list)[2] <- cc_res$labels$x_sig_name
    names(table_list)[3] <- cc_res$labels$y_sig_name
    
    col_logFC_x <- sprintf("logFC (%s)", conf$x_label)
    col_FDR_x <- sprintf("FDR (%s)", conf$x_label)
    col_logFC_y <- sprintf("logFC (%s)", conf$y_label)
    col_FDR_y <- sprintf("FDR (%s)", conf$y_label)
    
    for (t_name in names(table_list)) {
      df <- table_list[[t_name]]
      
      if (nrow(df) > 0) {
        display_df <- df %>%
          mutate(
            logFC_X = round(logFC_X, 3),
            logFC_Y = round(logFC_Y, 3),
            FDR_X = formatC(FDR_X, format = "e", digits = 2),
            FDR_Y = formatC(FDR_Y, format = "e", digits = 2)
          ) %>%
          rename(
            !!col_logFC_x := logFC_X,
            !!col_FDR_x := FDR_X,
            !!col_logFC_y := logFC_Y,
            !!col_FDR_y := FDR_Y
          )
        
        if (isTRUE(getOption('knitr.in.progress'))) {
          html_table <- kableExtra::kbl(display_df, format = "html", align = "c", 
                                        caption = sprintf("Target Category: %s", t_name)) %>%
            kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
            kableExtra::scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")
          
          cat(as.character(html_table))
          
        } else {
          cat(sprintf("\n**Target Category: %s**\n\n", t_name))
          print(rmarkdown::paged_table(display_df))
        }
        
      } else {
        cat(sprintf("> No features met the significance criteria for **%s**.\n", t_name))
      }
      cat("\n\n<br>\n\n") 
    }
    
  } else {
    cat("*No significant overlapping drivers found between these datasets.* \n\n")
  }
}
```
